name: shared static layout must not overlap classes co-active through another path
description: b is reachable from root alternative 2 directly and from alternative 1 through m, so a and b can be active together. The cheap alternative 1 makes m read a and b at once (5 pages live) and does not fit in 4 pages; a certificate that wrongly called a and b exclusive would overlap them and accept that infeasible cheaper plan.
